three_separated_questions.question: Do implementations agree on the same observable?
three_separated_questions.purpose: Isolate cross-tool parameterization differences (bulk-solvent masking, scaling, restraint dictionaries, hydrogen placement, secondary-structure definitions) on the exact same coordinate and reflection inputs.

three_separated_questions.question: What supports the final model's quality for its intended use?
three_separated_questions.purpose: Report absolute fit, stereochemistry, data quality, and fold/interface metrics on the final model with explicit resolution and applicability context.

three_separated_questions.question: What improved or regressed relative to the actual input?
three_separated_questions.purpose: Quantify direct before-vs-after coordinate shifts, B-factor shifts, atom/water/ligand inventory changes, reflection-set retention, and R-factor/geometry deltas relative to the actual starting model.

implementation_agreement.question: Do independent software implementations agree on the same observable when applied to the packaged 1SAR round-4 model (data/1sar_final.pdb) and reflection set (data/1sar.mtz)?

observables.agreement_assessment: On matched 723-reflection free sets, gemmi sfcalc, phenix.model_vs_data, and REFMAC5 place R-free within a 0.0020 window (0.2116 to 0.2136), while Servalcat sigmaa reports 0.2209 under a different recorded test-set count (n_free=362) and scaling path. The +0.0058 R-work / +0.0020 R-free offset between gemmi_rfactor.py (bin-rescaled) and phenix.model_vs_data is descriptive and informational.

Standalone MolProbity (3.63, 11 bad-overlap pairs over 3,027 H-built atoms) and mmtbx.validation_summary (3.13) differ by 0.50 clashes/1000 atoms on data/1sar_final.pdb; raw H-built coordinates were not retained, so the 0.50 difference is recorded without causal attribution.

REFMAC5 (0.0105 A / 1.4957 deg) and mmtbx.validation_summary (0.007 A / 0.85 deg) differ by 0.0035 A and 0.6457 deg on data/1sar_final.pdb; matched bond counts and raw restraint-library outputs were not retained, and the agent-reported 0.004 A / 0.99 deg values belong to the absent round-7 model.
DSSP and P-SEA agree on 169/192 residues (88.02% Q3); the 23 boundary differences arise because DSSP uses backbone H-bond energies whereas P-SEA uses CA-only distance/dihedral criteria.

final_model_quality_support.question: What measurements support the packaged final model's (data/1sar_final.pdb, round 4) quality for downstream structural analysis at 2.50 A packaged/MTZ dataset resolution (49.972-2.500 A in data/1sar.mtz; 1.80 A deposited 1SAR reference)?

dimer_interface_and_fold_conservation_vs.active_site_and_ligand_note: Chainwise backbone fold and AB dimer interface match deposited 1SAR closely (DockQ = 0.9445, chain CA RMSD 0.191 / 0.180 A), and A:97:SO4 is retained (mean B = 17.588 A^2), whereas B:97:SO4 was removed in packaged round 4 and A:98:CA (B = 42.73 A^2) and B:98:NA (B = 22.85 A^2) were added.

change_relative_to_input.question: What improved, stayed invariant, or regressed between the actual starting model/data (data/1sar.pdb, data/1sar.mtz) and the packaged final model/data (data/1sar_final.pdb, data/1sar_final.mtz)?

reflection_data_retention.interpretation: All 723 free-R reflections and 6,494 positive-F work reflections preserve identical (F-obs, SIGF-obs, R-free-flags) values in data/1sar_final.mtz. However, audit_mtz_retention flags 'not_preserved' because 11 input work reflections with F=0.0 in data/1sar.mtz were written as NaN in data/1sar_final.mtz and 14 all-NaN reflection rows were appended.

missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.description: The trajectory log (claude_iterations.log:510, :752) reports a round-7 model with R-work = 0.1488, R-free = 0.1989, 159 waters (1,654 heavy atoms), and restored B:97:SO4, but that coordinate file was never packaged into cdba2c07-daff-4f60-ae96-12452b3a5fbb_artifacts.zip. Instead, data/1sar_final.pdb is the round-4 PHENIX model (SHA-256 8cbc1650f8be5a3833f98833fa514ec7d490c2c3bb9aa930413abac05e2a510b, 146 waters, 1,641 heavy atoms), while intermediate rounds 5 and 6 were saved separately as data/1sar_round5.pdb and data/1sar_round6.pdb.
missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.handling_rule: Assess data/1sar_final.pdb strictly as the round-4 packaged model and record round 7 as an unverified log-only claim.

missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.description: Deposited PDB entry 1SAR (data/pdb_mtz/1sar_deposited.pdb, 1991 deposition) records 'REMARK 3 FREE R VALUE : NULL'. Any pass criterion requiring comparison against deposited R-free is mathematically unevaluable.

Running aimless on data/1sar.mtz fails with 'hkl_unmerge_list::prepare - EMPTY' because data/1sar.mtz contains merged structure-factor amplitudes (F-obs, SIGF-obs) rather than unmerged diffraction intensities.
missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.handling_rule: Record T13 merging statistics (R_merge, R_meas, R_pim, CC1/2) as not_applicable_merged_input and use ctruncate / phenix.model_vs_data for merged reflection diagnostics.

missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.description: 11 input work reflections with F=0.0 in data/1sar.mtz became NaN in data/1sar_final.mtz (reducing eligible reflections from 7,228 to 7,217) and 14 all-NaN HKL rows were added. All 723 free-R reflections and 6,494 positive-F work reflections are preserved.
missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.handling_rule: Compute independent R-factor checks against the original input data/1sar.mtz and report the 11 invalidated zero-F work reflections explicitly.

missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.description: Historical April/May oracle measurements in EVAL_1sar_cdba2c07_2026-09-23.yaml (such as starting-model phenix.model_vs_data R-work 0.3334 / R-free 0.3956 and mmtbx.validation_summary clashscore 31.66) are preserved from frozen evaluation rows without retained raw stdout logs, whereas start-vs-final coordinate, B-factor, atom/water/ligand inventory, and MTZ reflection-retention metrics are freshly derived directly from the archived PDB and MTZ bytes.
missing_conflicting_and_inapplicable_evi.handling_rule: Distinguish directly recomputed byte-level audit metrics from transcribed historical evaluation rows.

cross_cohort_findings.unchanged_control_invariance: In unchanged_null (subject='null', n=22), phenix and gemmi delta R-free agree tightly (median |d_phenix - d_gemmi| = 0.0007), while REFMAC5 (evaluable on 19/22 targets; 3/22 two-path-only: 9YGW, 8R5K, 8QXQ) shows smaller deltas (median d_refmac = +0.0018 vs median d_phenix = +0.0035) and triggers solver-disagreement notes on 2/22 targets (8RFF on F-data, 9TXE on F-geom). Separating Question 1 (implementation agreement) from Question 3 (change relative to input) keeps solver-convention differences distinct from physical model changes.
cross_cohort_findings.damaged_control_sensitivity: Both damaged_sa (median d_phenix = +0.0209, 18/22 F-data flags, 2/22 F-shift flags) and damaged_dynamics (median d_phenix = +0.2629, median shift = 0.2465 A, 22/22 F-data and 22/22 F-shift flags, 13/22 F-geom flags) show strong R-free regressions across phenix, gemmi, and REFMAC5, confirming cross-solver sensitivity to physical model degradation.
cross_cohort_findings.recovered_control_protonation_contrast: Comparing recovered_unprotonated_solvent (round 4, n=22) with recovered_protonated_ordered_solvent (round 10, n=22) isolates the effect of phenix.ready_set riding hydrogens + ordered_solvent=True: median d_phenix improves from +0.0188 (22/22 F-data flags) in round 4 to +0.0063 (9/22 F-data flags; 8/22 improved below deposited R-free) in round 10, while median all-residue shift remains small (0.0435 A in round 4 vs 0.0422 A in round 10).
